description: Retrieve scheduled, published, draft, and failed posts, newest first, with per-profile delivery status. Every profile that received a post carries `url`, the link to the live copy - give the user that link when they ask where a post went. Returns pagination plus counts per status.

all.description: Return every matching post in one response, ignoring pagination.

limit.description: Posts per page. Defaults to 9 on the backend.

status.description: Only return posts in this state. Defaults to all.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (project) id to act on, from list_workspaces. Omit to use the caller's default workspace. Always pass this when the user belongs to more than one workspace.

name: list_posts
